newsitem.title: USA: D&P reaffirms Olympic Financial rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P reaffirms Olympic Financial rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said it has taken Olympic Financial Corp off rating watch-uncertain and reaffirmed the company's $145 million of senior unsecured notes rating of double-B.
The action follows an announcement by Olympic Financial that it does not expect to be sold in the near term, Duff & Phelps said in a statement.

In August 1996, Olympic Financial said it intended to pursue the sale of the company and expected to be sold over the subsequent two months. Since that announcement, and the resignation of the founder and chairman, no material strategic changes have taken place.

Duff & Phelps said it views Olympic Financial as having a well-devised underwriting system and an impressive proprietary credit scoring model. Additionally, assumptions used in estimating loan sale gains have been adequate and have become more conservative over the last few quarters, increasing earnings quality and balance-sheet integrity, it said.
